name: Huntorr
description: Huntorr is a quick and simple tool for performing torrent searches against the three top torrent sites and automatically adding them to your qBittorrent client.

variables.name: qBittorrent - Host
variables.description: The IP address or hostname of your qBittorrent instance.

variables.name: qBittorrent - Port
variables.description: The port number of your qBittorrent Web UI.

variables.name: qBittorrent - Username
variables.description: The username for your qBittorrent Web UI.

variables.name: qBittorrent - Password
variables.description: The password for your qBittorrent Web UI.

variables.name: Media Servers - Addresses
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Plex or Jellyfin server addresses to notify after adding torrents (e.g. Plex:http://192.168.1.2:32400, Jellyfin:http://192.168.1.2:8096)

variables.name: Media Servers - Tokens
variables.description: Token for your Plex or Jellyfin server(s) to allow Huntorr to notify them of new content. (e.g. Plex:abc, Jellyfin:def)

variables.name: Media Servers - Library Name
variables.description: Name of the library to update on your media server(s) after adding torrents.

author: nwithan8
